title: Strategic Content Partnership with TIME
summary: We’re partnering with TIME and its 101 years of archival content to enhance responses and provide links to stories on Time.com
body: We’re partnering with TIME and its 101 years of archival content to enhance responses and provide links to stories on Time.com
summaryZh: OpenAI与具有101年历史的新闻媒体TIME（时代周刊）建立战略内容伙伴关系，旨在将TIME的丰富档案内容整合到OpenAI的对话大模型中，为用户提供更准确的回答并直接提供原文链接，体现了AI大模型与传统版权媒体合作模式的新进展。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与TIME达成战略内容合作，增强大模型的实时信息检索和引用能力。
